title: Keep three low-risk behaviours as they are, with no spend?
bluf: Three tickets ask whether to change something small or costly. (1) An issued report downloads under the renamed customer's file name: keep (low severity; the fix needs a frozen migration). (2) A larger or second Azure plan for slow browser reads: no spend until the Server-Timing measurement exists. (3) Five open notes from the B193 timing gate: accept as measured, effects under 0.02% of the warm-read floor. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-203, HPSMPOC-237, HPSMPOC-246

options.label: Keep all three as is
options.detail: No spend, no change; recorded as ruled.

default_action: Option A: keep as is; record ruling.
